title: kbingest.py survey says nothing when the checkout is at another commit than --rev
goal: kbingest.py survey REPO --rev REV prints its worktree: line whenever the checked-out files are not REV's (HEAD's tree differs from REV's, or uncommitted changes), so an agent does not read the checkout for facts pinned to REV; the strict xfail marker on test_autonomous_converge_survey_warns_of_a_checkout_off_the_commit is removed.
